stats: Honour is an additional resource you have to manage within the Trial of the Sekhemas. A percentage of the damage you take from enemies in the Trial will be taken from your Honour. If your Honour reaches zero then the Trial is failed.
Your starting and maximum Honour are the sum of your maximum Life, Energy Shield and Runic Ward. Your maximum Mana is also added if you have [passive_keystone_mind_over_matter|Mind Over Matter].
